img_470.description: Very coarse pixelation. Beige vellum with a faint circular outline. In the middle there are two horizontal darker greyish-brown shapes, one above the other, with a pale blue-grey stroke under the lower one. No legs or limbs are visible.
img_470.central_figure: two elongated horizontal shapes stacked one above the other, possibly two fish or a figure on a base
img_470.sign_reason: Two stacked elongated shapes could suggest Pisces, but pixelation is too heavy to see fins, tails or heads; not enough to decide.

img_949.description: Coarse pixelation. Beige background. In the centre a dark grey-green shape like a bowl, boat or crescent with raised ends, with a lighter brown rectangle (possibly a painted-over patch) beneath it and a faint brown smudge above.
img_949.central_figure: a dark cup- or boat-shaped object, possibly a vessel or a crouching animal body
img_949.sign_reason: Only a cup/boat silhouette is visible; no legs, claws, horns or human form can be distinguished.

img_800.description: Almost uniform beige pixel blocks with a few scattered grey-blue pixels near the centre and a lighter rectangle (likely a masking patch). No recognisable drawing.
img_800.sign_reason: No figure visible at this degradation level.

img_414.description: Coarse pixelation. Beige background; in the centre a pale green horizontal bar above a red horizontal bar with an upturned left end, like a small red crescent or boat. A faint lighter patch below.
img_414.central_figure: a green horizontal shape above a red horizontal shape, possibly two small animals/fish or an object
img_414.sign_reason: Two stacked horizontal coloured shapes could be two fish (Pisces), but no detail confirms it.

img_849.description: Coarse pixelation. Beige background; in the centre two vertical forms side by side: a faint pale green one on the left with a short green stroke above, and a darker blue-grey one on the right curving at the bottom like a hook or foot.
img_849.central_figure: two upright forms side by side, possibly two standing figures or an arch/doorway
img_849.sign_reason: Two upright forms could hint at a pair of figures (Gemini) but they might equally be one object; too degraded.

img_170.description: Coarse pixelation. Scattered small red-and-blue blotches around the edges (top left, top right, right, bottom), faint green lines curving through the centre. Looks like the edge of a ring of small coloured figures with the centre largely empty or faint.
img_170.central_figure: faint green curved lines, possibly a plant or a faint drawing; surrounding small coloured figures
img_170.sign_reason: No central animal or person can be distinguished.

img_617.description: Nearly uniform beige blocks with one small grey pixel and one small red pixel; no drawing discernible.

img_671.description: Coarse pixelation. Faint blue-grey strokes in the centre: a curved stroke with an orange-brown fill at upper middle, a blue-grey blob to the right, and a short vertical stroke lower left. Could be a faint human or animal outline.
img_671.central_figure: a faint outlined figure, possibly a person or animal, too blurred to identify
img_671.sign_reason: Outline is fragmentary; no defining features.

img_491.description: Coarse pixelation. Beige background with a single small blue/teal blob in the centre and a darker greyish smudge below it; a small olive pixel at lower left.
img_491.central_figure: a small blue object or figure, unrecognisable
img_491.sign_reason: Only a colour blob; no shape.

img_477.description: Coarse pixelation. A clear red four-legged animal in the centre seen in profile: raised neck and head on the left with what may be an upright ear or horn, a horizontal body, legs down at front and back, possibly a tail at the right. A green patch at the head (perhaps foliage or a horn) and green strokes under the feet (ground). A brown rectangle under the belly (likely a masking patch). A dark brown circle at the left edge.
img_477.central_figure: a red four-legged animal (quadruped) standing on green ground
img_477.sign_reason: A quadruped narrows it to Aries, Taurus, Leo or Capricorn (or Sagittarius' horse body), but horns, mane or fish tail cannot be resolved. The upright head and slender body lean slightly towards a goat or sheep, but too weakly to name a sign.

img_780.description: Coarse pixelation. Same layout as img_477 but in olive-brown: a four-legged animal in profile with raised neck/head on the left, horizontal body, a dark green patch at the head; faint blue-green ground line beneath; a lighter rectangle under the body.
img_780.central_figure: an olive-brown four-legged animal standing on a faint ground line
img_780.sign_reason: Quadruped silhouette only; horns, mane or tail shape not resolvable, so Aries/Taurus/Leo/Capricorn cannot be separated.

img_401.description: Coarse pixelation with faded pinkish tones. In the centre a faint pink four-legged animal in profile (raised head on left, horizontal body), green patch near the head and green ground marks below. Small red-pink spots scattered around the edges (top left, top right, right) like small surrounding figures.
img_401.central_figure: a faint pink four-legged animal on green ground, with small coloured figures around it
img_401.sign_reason: Quadruped outline only and very faint; species not identifiable.

recognise_source: Possibly: the faded vellum, the small coloured figures arranged around circular diagrams, and the central animals resemble the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), but at this pixelation level this is a guess, not a confident recognition. I did not use this to choose signs.
